title: Handoff
summary: A /handoff skill that writes a resume-here file for the next agent session: the goal, where things stand, what failed, and the next step.

explain.what: The handoff skill writes a short file that lets another agent session, or a future you, pick up the work without re-explaining it: the goal, the current state, files in flight, what changed, what was tried and failed, and the single next step.
explain.does: Day to day you say /handoff when context is running low or you are switching tools. In a git repo the file goes in docs/handoffs/<branch>.md or .handoffs/<branch>.md, kept out of git so it never rides a PR; the next agent starts by reading it.
changes: ~/.claude/skills/handoff/ and ~/.codex/skills/handoff/ (the skill, for the harnesses you have)
explain.undo: Uninstalling removes the skill folders. A file you edited after installing is kept and reported. Handoff files already written in your projects stay.

changes: ~/.claude/skills/handoff/SKILL.md (Claude Code; Grok reads this folder too)
